title: Structure of the search state
statement: Let $n,j\in\mathbb{N}$, and for each $r\in\mathbb{N}$ let $D_r$ be a Boolean circuit on $n+r$ inputs in which every gate has distinct arguments, every negation gate has exactly one argument, and every gate has at most two arguments. After $j$ stages of the search construction, the gate list is acyclic, its output list has length $j$ and contains only vertices of the circuit, and the vertex $n$ is a vertex of the circuit. Every gate in the list has distinct arguments, every negation gate has exactly one argument, and every gate has at most two arguments.
hypotheses_covered: Each $D_r$ has distinct arguments at every gate
Each negation gate of $D_r$ has exactly one argument
Each gate of $D_r$ has at most two arguments
